title: Employment and Deployment Restrictions on Healthcare Professionals Undergoing Investigations for Patient Abuse Charges
what_it_is: Employment and Deployment Restrictions on Healthcare Professionals Undergoing Investigations for Patient Abuse Charges

sections.label: Healthcare professionals patient abuse investigations
sections.summary: The Minister was asked about employment restrictions, yearly charge numbers since 2010, and how many charged professionals kept working in Singapore healthcare.

sentences.speaker: Miss Rachel Ong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether there are any restrictions on the employment or deployment of healthcare professionals who are undergoing investigation for charges relating to patient abuse; (b) for each year since 2010, what is the number of healthcare professionals who have been charged for patient abuse; and (c) of these, how many continued to work in the healthcare industry in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes cases of patient abuse by healthcare professionals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The licensees must take steps as soon as possible to manage the risk of recurrent abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This may include the reassignment of a healthcare professional to non-clinical duties or to require the healthcare professional to take a leave of absence to minimise further patient interactions while investigations are ongoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since 2010, four healthcare professionals have been convicted of offences related to patient abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Three are no longer practising and one returned to practice after serving a 15-month suspension.
